_sources.treaty_claim_on_return: Instructions for Form 1040-NR (2025), 'Amounts Exempt Under a Treaty', example 1: the payer withheld on / reported only the taxable part (W-2) and reported the treaty-exempt part on Form 1042-S — the exemption is NOT claimed a second time on the return; the W-2 amount goes on line 1a and the exempt amount on line 1k.

description: NR-002: Chinese F-1 student (first calendar year), employer split the pay with Form 8233: the treaty-exempt $5,000 was paid on Form 1042-S (income code 20, exemption code 04 = exempt under a tax treaty, Instructions for Form 1042-S) and only the taxable $3,000 is on the W-2, with $500 withheld. The exemption was already excluded by the payer, so the on-return claim is $0 and line 1a is the W-2 amount alone; line 1k still lists the $5,000. Same $303 tax as NR-001; refund $197.
